what: Fusion symbols whose trade_mode is not SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL (4): no new position can be opened, and research/fetch_universe._fetch_intraday therefore writes NO intraday (M1/M5/M15/M30) parquet for them (reason NOT_TRADEABLE); scripts/refresh_tail.refresh_symbol only extends a file that already exists. A factor named here had no intraday bars in the lake.
measured_by: research/fetch_universe.py (the comment at the trade_mode field records the 13 names from that pass: 250 symbols offered, 237 trade_mode FULL)
authority: evidence of last resort: research/basket_mismatch.py reads the registry's own trade_mode / tradeable / intraday_coverage first, and only falls back to this list when the registry row carries none of them (the origin stump of universe.json does not)
